name: Sinoplast
summary: Guangdong Sinoplast Advanced Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of modified engineering plastics. The company provides high-performance engineering materials, special functional materials, and other materials, including PC, PA, ABS, PC/ABS, PC/PBT, LDS materials, NMT materials, hardened PC/IMT materials, PPA nylon materials, LED bracket materials, new energy vehicle materials, micro-acoustic and connector materials, mobile phone materials, tablet computer materials, notebook computer materials, smart wearable materials, and smart home materials.
